accounting, FP&A, and Big 4 audit (PwC & Deloitte). Currently working as a Real Estate Private Equity Fund

and GL management across private equity real estate fund structures. Big 4 background includes private equity audit at 
Deloitte (fund NAV, LP capital accounts, fair value, waterfall reviews) and AWM/Insurance/Banking audit at PwC — 
providing a strong command of fund financial statements, valuation frameworks, and investor reporting standards. 
Worked for Clients like CIBC, RBC, JP Morgan. Goldman Sachs, Franklin Templeton, Blackstone, KKR. Proven track 
record of building automated Power BI and Excel dashboards that reduced reporting delivery time by 35%, and leading 
annual planning cycles and scenario modelling that directly informed senior leadership decisions. Proficient in Yardi, 
Oracle ERP, Alteryx, US GAAP, Ind AS (IFRS), IGAAP, and advanced Excel.
